_comment: Yearly average grid carbon intensity for regions with no free hourly data source. Lifecycle gCO2e/kWh (full lifecycle incl. upstream methane), the same basis as GreenPick's per-fuel factors, so these compare fairly with live/typical regions. National figures: no hourly or sub-national lifecycle data is freely available for these grids. Used with quality='annual_average'; no hourly profile, so no timing advice.
_source: Ember yearly electricity data (lifecycle CO2 intensity of electricity generation), via Our World in Data grapher 'carbon-intensity-electricity'. CC BY 4.0.

SG.note: About 95% natural gas; a yearly figure is a fair description of this steady grid.

JP.note: National average; the Tokyo (TEPCO) area mix differs somewhat and varies by hour.

IN.note: National average; Maharashtra (Mumbai, Pune) runs about 6% above it on Ember's state-level data.

AU.note: National average; New South Wales (Sydney) is more coal-heavy and runs higher, so treat this as a lower bound for Sydney.
